text.p: Workforce Systems Corp said Wednesday its board approved a one-for-four reverse split of its common stock, effective April 3.
The company said the board also approved increasing the number of authorized common shares to 100 million from 10 million as of March 20.

After the reverse split, authorized common shares will total 25 million, the company said, and beginning April 3, Workforce Systems' common stock will trade on the OTC Bulletin Board under the symbol "WFSY."

The company also said it will redeem one million shares of Series D Preferred Stock held by its principal shareholder, Yucatan Holding Co, in exchange for 2.4 million common shares, effective March 24.
The company said these actions are part of its efforts to get a listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
The company's subsidiaries are involved in manufacturing, marketing and distribution, and employee staffing services.

Its manufacturing unit, Industrial Fabrication & Repair, provides fabrication, machining and design of maintenance and production related equipment. Its staffing units, American Industrial Management and Outside Industrial Services, provide light industrial and light manufacturing employee staffing on a contract basis.
